<!-- Code generated by scripts/generate-docs.ts (run `npm run docs:generate`); DO NOT EDIT. -->

Run these commands from the Command Palette (`Ctrl+Shift+P` / `Cmd+Shift+P`), or bind them to keyboard shortcuts.

| Command | Identifier |
| ------- | ---------- |
| **Achievements: Enable / Disable** | `achievements.enable` |
| **Achievements: Settings** | `achievements.settings` |
| **Achievements: Show** | `achievements.show` |
| **Achievements: Quick Menu** | `achievements.statusBarMenu` |
